precondition: Root must view and decide the queued window234 full/true-crop images before changing canonical06 again.
steps: Retain exact native-reviewed source and original reference6-main.js before any installation.
Keep the existing opaque normal/depth pass and GTAO geometric radius/thickness/samples/denoise settings.
Set GTAOPass.output to Off; remove its multiply blend from the beauty composer.
Install only after initial room cube/PMREM captures. Existing material hooks and cache keys must remain composed.
Every frame: render actual opaque depth, run contactAO.render(renderer,null,null) to compute its public gtaoMap, enable the main-view indirect shader, render beauty composer, disable in finally.
Keep the planar reflector guard; main-camera visibility must be disabled throughout reflected-camera renders.
Update truthful limitation/diagnostic metadata. Direct sun/lamp values, camera, exposure, geometry, sculpture, materials and floor reflection settings are otherwise held.
Use a new official FIFO native iteration for full/true-crop/low images and all actual sampler/link/GL diagnostics, then inspect the pixels. Do not claim success from shader text alone.
shaderSemantics: Applies the pinned ordinary PBR indirect diffuse, indirect clearcoat/sheen and roughness-aware indirect specular occlusion operations to a native screen visibility field; it does not multiply direct lighting or emissive radiance.
risk: One additional sampler on affected programs. Verify actual compilation in the native context, including reflection and transmission passes; no assumption that a previous texture budget still holds.
